memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Depression
  - Status: Persistent low mood, PHQ-9 12, mild insomnia.
  - Plan: Start sertraline 50 mg OD after breakfast; counsel on sleep hygiene; PHQ-9 in 4 weeks.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: BMI 28, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off), ALT 48 U/L.
  - Plan: Lifestyle advice – reduced refined carbs, 30 min walk daily; start silymarin 140 mg TDS with meals; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD at night; repeat LFT in 3 months.
- Weight: 78 kg, waist 92 cm.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: Dr Suresh Rao, Hepatology, Vikram Hospital.
Reason: Persistent NAFLD with borderline elevated liver enzymes despite lifestyle and statin; request fibrosis assessment (FibroScan) and guidance on further management.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: From Dr Suresh Rao: FibroScan shows CAP 260 dB/m (steatosis), stiffness 6.8 kPa (F0‑F1). Advise continue lifestyle, silymarin, low‑dose statin; repeat FibroScan in 12 months. No pharmacologic therapy needed at present.
